_comment: Site-token alias overlay for the TB-direct site query (design §2.3, D1). TB textSearch is an unanchored substring match: the anchored client-side filter '^{brand}-({tokens})(?![0-9])' correctly rejects numeric-neighbour bleed (gk-62091) but would MISS split sites whose devices live under a TEXT-token variant (md-1110 has 6 devices as md-1110-* and 112 as md-1110meridian-*). Each entry lists the EXTRA name tokens a site's devices may carry BESIDES its bare siteNo; the bare siteNo is always included implicitly, so most sites need NO entry here. Keyed by siteNo. Tokens are matched case-insensitively against the normalised device name. Refreshed by a documented OFFLINE estate-scan job (never a runtime full-tenant pull) — seeded from the validation report's 50 collision pairs / known text-token split sites.
